title: 菲律宾财长雷克托：开放多个领域，清洁能源与关键矿产成吸金热点
speaker: Ralph Recto

segments.en: What specific industries is open to investment? Oh, very recently in 2022, we opened several public services to foreign investors: airports, airlines, shipping, telecommunications, renewable energy, rails and subways, roads and expressways.
segments.zh: 哪些行业向外资开放？2022年我们开放了多项公共服务：机场、航空、航运、电信、可再生能源、铁路地铁、公路高速等。

segments.en: So we've liberalized a lot of the sectors in the Philippines to foreign investment, and we are very actively pursuing investments in the electronics, semiconductor space.
segments.zh: 我们已大幅放宽外资准入，并积极吸引电子和半导体领域的投入。

segments.en: We also are garnering a lot of investor interest in any form of clean energy: onshore wind, offshore wind, solar, hydro, geothermal.
segments.zh: 同时，各类清洁能源也吸引了大量关注：陆上风电、海上风电、光伏、水电、地热等。

segments.en: And third, we also are attracting a lot of investments in the critical mineral space after passing the Mining Fiscal Regime Act. You know, the Philippines is very blessed to be abundant in nickel and copper, two of the minerals that are very important in clean energy.
segments.zh: 第三，通过矿业财政制度法案后，关键矿产领域也吸引了大量投入。菲律宾盛产镍和铜，这两种矿产对清洁能源至关重要。

segments.en: So we're hoping to really push the processing of these minerals back home, so that we have value-added exports.
segments.zh: 我们希望推动这些矿产在国内加工，实现高附加值出口。
